what: Clicking a link to another page makes a light panel fill from the bottom of the screen upward and cover it — five layers of noise are added to the horizontal edge before the threshold so the edge tears off in pieces rather than waves, and torn-off fragments float ahead. It covers in .52s and transitions, then on the arriving page it clears toward the same upward direction starting at the 36% point of a 1.4s length (flipping only the opaque side for one continuous directional motion). The curve is a first-order filter with a time constant of .5s (fast at first, soft at the end). The panel is a gradient from #efefef at the top → a lighter color below (skin variable). WebGL shader

options.clear: Walk length (seconds), default 1.4 — the leading skip share is skipped
options.skip: Skip the first part of the walk (0~1), default .36 — dead time where the panel sits still because the edge is still off screen
options.amp: How strongly noise pulls the boundary (share of screen height), default .175
options.reach: Multiplier applied to amp, default 2.7 — page-turn·loader panels tear more than the tear between blocks
options.scale: Noise scale, default 3 — larger means finer fragments
options.detail: Noise layer count (1~6), default 5 — 1 is smooth waves, 5 is fragments
options.soft: Edge half-width, default .001 — smaller makes the shards crisper
options.nav: when off, links are not intercepted — from a transition tool such as barba, fire an fx:tear event (on root{ phase: 'cover'|'clear', done }sends ) to use it
options.--fx-sheet-top · --fx-sheet-foot: Colors above and below the panel: the default --kf-contrast-bg and a slightly lighter one. To cover briefly with another color like a loader, set a class on html and change the two variables of .fx-tear (re-read on every turn)
options.[data-fx-part=hide]: Child that hides at .2s while the panel is present

use: <body data-fx="tear-sheet-page"> · To use with barba, data-fx-tear-sheet-page="nav: off" Leave it as is, and on leave call body.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fx:tear', { detail: { phase: 'cover', done } }))
note: The original bends the noise plate with lens distortion (-.275) and samples the noise grid in other coordinates — the part places it in screen-ratio coordinates with grid 3 to match the original’s fragment size (a bit over 1/5 of the screen width). Without WebGL it skips ahead instead of waiting.

from.where: shared.js page transition (barba leave · enter) and loader end (red sheet) — original transition-sheet.js: coverMs 520, uncoverMs 1400, outFrom .36, ease mask (easeTau 500), dispAmp .175, navScale 2.7, dispDetail 5, soft .001, direction up, top #EFEFEF foot #FFFFFF
